trust_decision.summary: The Assembler decides, per object value, whether a JSON key is materialized by plain assignment (hits the inherited __proto__ setter and replaces the new object's prototype) or as an own data property via Object.defineProperty; the same decision is duplicated in the reviver code path and in the separate FlexAssembler, so the protection must hold at all three write sites.

landing_point.why: The advisory summary literally names "Assembler writes this.current[this.key] on plain objects", and that statement is the plain assignment in Assembler._saveValue; the public subpath stream-json/assembler.js re-exports this class unchanged (src/assembler.js:3).

fix_sites.entry_point: Assembler / assembler() default path: assembler.js tapChain, consume(), connectTo(), Assembler.connectTo() (published as stream-json/assembler.js and stream-json/web/assembler.js)
Assembler with the reviver option (constructor aliases this._saveValue = this._saveValueWithReviver at src/core/assembler.js:30, so the whole value path is replaced when a reviver is passed)
fix_sites.module_kind: core library class, option-selected code path

fix_sites.entry_point: FlexAssembler / flexAssembler() (published as stream-json/utils/flex-assembler.js and stream-json/web/utils/flex-assembler.js)
fix_sites.module_kind: second implementation in core/utils (separate public subpath)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: FlexAssembler lives in core/utils as an opt-in utility for custom containers, is published on a different subpath, and the advisory names only `Assembler`, so a solver can call it a neighbouring feature rather than part of the reported flaw.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: JSON.parse parity at the same sink: a `__proto__` key must still materialize as an own, enumerable, configurable data property (so Object.keys and deepEqual match JSON.parse and the prototype stays Object.prototype), and the reviver must still be able to drop the property by returning undefined. An over-broad fix that skips or deletes `__proto__` keys (the usual hardening) silently loses legitimate dump data and breaks the existing reviver/parity contract.

O6_input_shapes: `__proto__` as a direct key of a top-level object ({"__proto__":{"isAdmin":true},"name":"bob"})
`__proto__` as a key of a nested object ({"user":{"__proto__":{...}},"name":"alice"})
`__proto__` with a null value (prototype set to null)
the same vectors with the reviver option enabled (second write site, src/core/assembler.js:180)
the same vectors through FlexAssembler with no objectRules (third write site, src/core/utils/flex-assembler.js:257)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: FlexAssembler objectRules branch: when a rule matches, the key goes to user-supplied rule.add(this.current, this.key, value) and the new __proto__ check is only in the `else` branch, so a rule whose container is a plain object and whose add does obj[k]=v keeps the original prototype-replacing write.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: materialization is delegated to the application's ObjectRule (the documented example builds a Map and finalizes with Object.fromEntries), so the library can argue the container write is user code; no built-in rule creates a plain object.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file, 3 lines above the fixed branch, but a different public option path (objectRules)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a built-in default ObjectRule (e.g. a plain-object rule) whose add does m[k] = v, selected when no user rule matches
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the file already branches on this.rule and exports objectRule/arrayRule helpers; adding a default container rule is a natural feature and its add would sit next to the fixed branch.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: streamer-level pair materialization that writes the key onto a fresh object instead of reading asm.current[key]
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: streamObject already owns the per-pair result object and reads asm.current[key], so a maintainer optimizing away the shared Assembler would naturally perform the key write here.

O9_family: prototype pollution via JSON key materialization on plain objects (CWE-1321)

O10_build.language: JavaScript (ESM, Node.js; Bun/Deno/browser also declared in package.json scripts)
O10_build.toolchain: npm install, then tape-six (`npm test` -> tape6 --flags FO) plus TypeScript checks (tsc --noEmit); one runtime dependency, stream-chain
O10_build.project_tests: tests/node/test-assembler.js, tests/node/test-flex-assembler.js, tests/web/test-assembler.js, tests/web/test-flex-assembler.js, plus the streamer tests (tests/node/test-stream-object.js, test-stream-array.js, test-stream-values.js); the fix appends one __proto__ parity test to each of the four assembler test files.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Patch only the line the report quotes (src/core/assembler.js:160), and harden it by skipping/deleting `__proto__` keys instead of defineProperty, never noticing the reviver alias at src/core/assembler.js:30 or the separate FlexAssembler in core/utils.
